messages.subject: extracting stuff from bootstrap object
parts:
Hello everyone,

I want to fit Nmix models using pcount() to lots of individual data sets, do a parametric bootstrap GOF test in each case and save the bootstrapped p-value. How can I do this ?

Typing the name of the object created with an unmarked bootstrap, say, pb, yields as part of the output this:

Parametric Bootstrap Statistics:
               t0 mean(t0 - t_B) StdDev(t0 - t_B) Pr(t_B > t0)
SSE          2154           1488             87.2       0.0000

I used str(pb) to see where I can get the value of, here, 0.000 for saving, but couldn't find it. I then tried to inspect the code for the function, but typing "parboot" or "unmarked::parboot" did not help either.

Thanks for your help.

Kind regards  -  Marc

messages.author: 6a288128bce8283d
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] extracting stuff from bootstrap object
parts:
Hi Marc,

Below a function I use to extract parboot results. Slight modifications would allow you to get what you want.

Cheers,
Richard

The function call is e.g.:
AMROb <- parboot (AMRO, nsim = 1000)
save.parboot (AMROb,"AMRO")


save.parboot <- function(object, species = NULL){

ï¿œï¿œï¿œ # save.parboot: a function for saving parboot outputs
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ # Author: Richard Schuster (ma...@richard-schuster.com
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ # 16 April 2012


ï¿œ #Fields to put into the dataframe
ï¿œ #t0ï¿œï¿œ mean(tB)ï¿œ StdDev(tB)ï¿œ mean(t0-tB) StdDev(t0-tB) Pr(tB > t0) nsim
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ t.star <- obj...@t.star
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ t0 <- object@t0
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ nsim <- nrow(t.star)


ï¿œï¿œï¿œ biasMat <- pMat <- matrix(NA, nsim, length(t0))
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ for(i in 1:nsim) {
ï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œ biasMat[i,] <- t0 - t.star[i,]
ï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œ pMat[i,] <- abs(t.star[i,] - 1) > abs(t0 - 1)
ï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œ }
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ mean.tB <- mean(t.star)
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ tB.se <- apply(t.star, 2, sd)
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ bias <- colMeans(biasMat)
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ bias.se <- apply(biasMat, 2, sd)
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ p.val <- colSums(pMat) / (1 + nsim)
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ stats <- data.frame("species" = species, "t0" = t0, "mean(tB)" = mean.tB, "StdDev(tB)" = tB.se, "mean(t0 - t_B)" = bias,
ï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œ "StdDev(t0 - t_B)" = bias.se, "Pr(t_B > t0)" = p.val, "nsim" = nsim,
ï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œï¿œ check.names = FALSE)
ï¿œï¿œï¿œ write.table(stats,append=T, "D://R_files/12_10_05_Birds_100m_resolved/parboot/parboot.csv", col.names=F)
}
